resources.string: This port runs the iPad version of FTL: Faster Than Light. It doesn\'t include the game itself.\n\nSelect your copy of the iPad app (an .ipa file, or a .zip of it), or a folder containing the extracted FTL.app. Only the files FTL and ftl.dat are copied into the app\'s private storage.
While you hold a finger down, shows a magnified view of what\'s under it. Slide to adjust and lift to tap.
Tap anywhere with two fingers to pause or resume.
Shows the whole screen in a corner while zoomed in. Tap it to zoom back out.
Android often closes apps in the background. When FTL starts with a run saved, go straight back to it instead of the title screen.
Zoom in on the map and upgrades
The beacon map and the upgrade and cargo screens fill the screen while they\'re open, so their text is easier to read. Pinch to look around; the view goes back when the window closes.
Event windows fill the screen while they\'re open. This hides the rest of the screen, like your crew and the enemy ship, while you choose.
The story text and choices in event windows. Larger text makes the window bigger too.
Takes effect the next time the game starts.
Sharp (renders at twice the game\'s resolution)

• Tap works like on the iPad.
• Hold a finger to see the magnifier, slide onto small buttons, then lift.
• Pinch to zoom in (up to 3×). Drag with two fingers to look around. Tap the minimap or pinch out to zoom back.
• Two-finger tap: pause or resume.
• Hold a finger still, then tap with another: a right click where the first finger is, for mods that use one (keep the second finger down and move the first to drag).
• Back: closes the open window or opens the game menu. On the title screen it asks to quit.
• Keyboard: Space pauses, 1–8 power weapons and drones (Shift removes power), A/S/D/F/W/E… power systems, J jump, U upgrades, C crew, I cargo, Z/X open or close all doors. 
• Mouse: left button taps and drags, right button is Back (a right click for mods that use one), the wheel zooms.
• Game controller: the left stick (or d-pad, for fine moves) steers a cursor and A taps there. B is Back, X pauses, LB/RB zoom, the right stick looks around, holding LT shows the magnifier, Start opens the menu.
The imported copy of FTL lives in the app\'s private storage. Your saves and settings are kept when you import again.
This removes the imported game files and restarts the app at the import screen. Saves are kept.
A short buzz when the magnifier appears, when a two-finger tap pauses, and on a right click for a mod. Follows the system\'s touch feedback setting.
Your run and your profile (unlocks, achievements, scores) are kept in the app\'s private storage, and uninstalling the app deletes them. Export them to keep a copy or to move them to another device.
No FTL saves found there. Pick a zip made with Export saves, or the files continue.sav, prof.sav or settings.ini.

Mods made for FTL 1.6 on PC can change ships, events, weapons and more.
Load Hyperspace, which mods like Multiverse are built on. Experimental: some mod features don\'t work yet and it may crash. Takes effect the next time the game starts.

Add mods made for FTL 1.6 on PC: the .ftl or .zip files used with ftlman or Slipstream. You can also open a downloaded mod with FTL. Tick the ones you want, put them in order (later ones win when two change the same thing), then apply. FTL restarts with them.
Mods that need Hyperspace, like Multiverse, can\'t work here yet.
Mods that need Hyperspace, like Multiverse, also need the Hyperspace switch in Settings turned on. It\'s experimental.

resources.string: Play without mods? They stay in the list, so you can apply them again later. FTL restarts.
%1$s doesn\'t look like an FTL mod: it should be a zip with folders such as data and img inside.
A run usually can\'t continue after its mods change, and trying can freeze the game. Set it aside to start fresh? Restore earlier saves, in settings, brings it back.

The game hasn\'t drawn anything for a while. This can happen when a saved run doesn\'t match the mods in use. Close FTL and open it again: it starts at the title screen and can save a log of what happened.
